notes: Re-recorded from the same source as w10_cup_physical_x0.3_a0.15_sl0.3t_n4 with --contact-from mujoco. There, contact was the bridge's stations.contact flag, which on this route is the wave pattern's planned contact, so a station could be flagged touching with no contact point. Here the flag is on exactly when MuJoCo has a contact between the station and the ball. Every other field comes from the same recording. No contact point was invented: a flag with no MuJoCo contact is set off, and source.contact_fix counts the changes.
